description: The whole record: the front matter, then the account in prose.
title: post-mortem

schema.description: The format version of this record. A version the tool does not know is refused, never guessed.

id.description: The identity: `pm-`, the day the failure was first seen, and a slug. It fixes the file name and survives a retitle.

title.description: What went wrong, in one line, as an assertion: the cause when it is known, the symptom while it is not.

description.description: One line saying what a reader who meets the same failure should take from the record.

date.description: The day the failure was first seen, YYYY-MM-DD.

runs.description: Every run this record answers. One cause can fail several runs, and each of them is answered by naming it here; a record that names none answers nothing and is refused.

components.description: Where the cause lives, as references of the layer: `file:<repository-relative path>`, `test:<path>`, or `<kind>:<identity>` for an object the layer holds (`rule:`, `adr:`, `claim:`, `skill:`). Each is an edge of the graph, so the record is reached from the page of every component it names. A reference must resolve while the record is not `resolved`; a record that is `analysed` or `resolved` names at least one.

signals.description: What the failure looks like from outside: text a failing log or a job's summary shows. `majordomus postmortem diagnose` searches a failure for these, so a signal is the shortest text that is this failure's and no other's.

fixed_by.description: What removed the cause: `commit:<sha>`, `pr:<number>`. Present exactly when the status is `resolved`.

prevention.description: What now stops the cause from returning or shortens the next diagnosis, as references of the layer: `test:<path>`, `file:<path>`, `rule:<identity>`, `issue:<id>`. Each must resolve.

related.description: What else of the layer the failure concerns, as `<kind>:<identity>`: the issue that plans the follow-up, the milestone, the decision, the intent or the claim it touched. Each must resolve, and each is an edge both ways: the issue's page names the record.

Run.description: One failed run of a workflow on the trunk.

workflow.description: The workflow's name as the forge reports it (`validate`, `pages`).

id.description: The forge's identifier of the run, as a string: it is an identity, never a quantity.

jobs.description: The jobs that failed in it, by name.

step.description: The step that failed, where one job failed in one step.

Cause.description: Why it failed, as a class and one sentence. The prose is the body's; this is what a table, a count and a diagnosis read.

summary.description: The cause in one sentence. For `undetermined`, what is known and what was ruled out.

Signal.description: One recognisable trace of the failure.

id.description: The signal's name within the record, lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.

text.description: The text itself, matched as written, ignoring case.

Body.description: The body is the account a reader comes for when the same job is red again.

sections.description: Every heading of the body, in document order, as the reader flattens it.

x-majordomus-sections.heading: Timeline
x-majordomus-sections.description: Optional: when it was seen, by whom, and how long the trunk stayed red.
